definitions.rationale: This guarded base equation defines digitResult(C,N) to preserve accumulator C when N is nonpositive; it is part of the mathematical digit-summary definition and does not model or replace program execution.
definitions.text:
rule digitResult(C, N) => C
    requires N <=Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This guarded terminal equation defines the one-digit positive case of digitResult by adding the indicator for a final digit equal to 7; Stage 1 treats it as a derived definitional equation, not as a separately proved reusable lemma.
definitions.text:
rule digitResult(C, N) =>
      C +Int (#if pyMod(N, 10) ==Int 7 #then 1 #else 0 #fi)
    requires N >Int 0
     andBool (N -Int pyMod(N, 10)) /Int 10 <=Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This fold-oriented recurrence defines digitResult for positive N by relating the accumulator after consuming N's last decimal digit and quotient to the named summary before that step; its direction controls simplification but it remains a mathematical definition.
definitions.text:
rule digitResult(
         C +Int
           (#if ((N %Int 10) +Int 10) %Int 10 ==Int 7
            #then 1 #else 0 #fi),
         (N -Int (((N %Int 10) +Int 10) %Int 10)) /Int 10)
       => digitResult(C, N)
    requires N >Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This guarded base equation defines fizzResult(C,N) as C for nonpositive N, corresponding to the empty prefix of candidate integers; it is a summary equation with no operational configuration.
definitions.text:
rule fizzResult(C, N) => C
    requires N <=Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This qualifying-case recurrence defines fizzResult for positive N when N-1 is divisible by 11 or 13, folding the digitResult contribution of that candidate into the outer mathematical summary.
definitions.text:
rule fizzResult(digitResult(C, N +Int -1), N +Int -1)
       => fizzResult(C, N)
    requires N >Int 0
     andBool (
       ((((N +Int -1) %Int 11) +Int 11) %Int 11 ==Int 0)
       orBool
       ((((N +Int -1) %Int 13) +Int 13) %Int 13 ==Int 0))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This complementary nonqualifying recurrence defines fizzResult for positive N when N-1 is divisible by neither 11 nor 13, preserving the accumulator while folding to the named outer summary.
definitions.text:
rule fizzResult(C, N +Int -1)
       => fizzResult(C, N)
    requires N >Int 0
     andBool notBool (
       ((((N +Int -1) %Int 11) +Int 11) %Int 11 ==Int 0)
       orBool
       ((((N +Int -1) %Int 13) +Int 13) %Int 13 ==Int 0))
    [simplification]
